library.create: plus icon button opens the creation menu
library.itemActions: horizontal ellipsis button on each row opens all permitted item actions
library.keyboard: button activation opens; Up/Down navigate; Escape closes and restores the originating button focus

templateCreation.presentation: previous first screenshot accepted; variable selection and defaults unchanged

templateLaunch.layout: one parameter per row, name left and field right
templateLaunch.hints: in-field placeholder at most; no explanatory paragraphs or dedicated error line
templateLaunch.invalid: red field state; accessible error remains associated with the field
templateLaunch.creation: disabled until required inputs are complete and valid

transfer.presentation: essential headings, affected objects and explicit action labels
transfer.import: additions, existing objects, separate conflict copies and settings checkbox
transfer.restore: additions, changes and removals; affected history/settings remain visible
transfer.backupSemantics: mandatory pre-restore snapshot and error handling remain unchanged

unsaved.visible: brief heading, affected document name and action buttons

scope: Prototype edits and wording implement the user correction. No real import, restoration, OS clipboard or production storage behavior is performed.
